title: ranunculus bullatus subsp. cyrenaicus
intro: Ranunculus bullatus subsp. cyrenaicus, commonly known as the Eastern Horned Crowsfoot or Cyrenaica Crowfoot, is a plant species belonging to the Buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus bullatus subsp. cyrenaicus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it beneficial for treating wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
